references.text: Paul quotes directly from Exodus 16:18 to encourage fair distribution among the believers in Corinth, so that those who have much share with those who have little, and no one has too much or too little.
The immediate context where God gives instructions to gather an omer per person, which verse 18 shows was fulfilled by God's miraculous provision.
Confirms the principle of gathering according to need—each gathered what they needed for food, in line with verse 18.
Agur's prayer for neither poverty nor riches, but only enough for daily sustenance, reflects the principle of sufficient provision shown in the manna miracle.
The prayer for daily bread in the Lord's Prayer reflects the principle of trusting God for daily provision, just as the Israelites received manna according to their daily needs.
